html: <main><button id="mark" data-hs-on-click="["set","marked",["not",["sig","marked"]]]"></button><svg id="plot" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><rect id="frame" width="100" height="100" data-hs-show="["sig","marked"]"></rect><template data-hs-each="["bars",0]"><g data-hs-key="["item",0,"id"]"><rect width="5" data-hs-attr="[["height",["str",["item",0,"height"]]]]"></rect><template data-hs-each="[["item",0,"marks"],1]"><line data-hs-attr="[["y1",["str",["item",1,""]]]]"></line></template></g></template><template data-hs-if="["sig","marked"]"><circle id="dot" r="2"></circle></template></svg></main>
